text:
Sam W: Heads up: critical glibc chain CVE found in base-image:v2026-03. Need coordinated rebuild + signing & audit retention changes. Proposing Tue 05:00 UTC cutover. :hourglass:
Alex R: +1. Need the exact RBAC delta and KMS access model (kms vs local) before cutover.
Sam W: Plan: 1) create service account ci-image-signer in ci namespace; 2) bind to images-signers role only; 3) forbid long-lived human cosign keys; 4) grant sec-devs audit-view only. Will paste YAML.
Maria (runtime): Will we overwrite tags or publish new ones? Runtime needs to pin canaries accordingly.
Jess - infra: Prefer new -rev1 tags to avoid accidental registry immutability issues. Also need staging bucket and canary cluster names.
Sam W: Decision: publish as v2026-03-rev1. Canaries: staging-canary, perf-canary.
Alex R: RBAC snippet: 
```
kubectl create serviceaccount ci-image-signer -n ci
kubectl create rolebinding ci-image-signer-binding --role=projects/images-signers --serviceaccount=ci:ci-image-signer -n images
```
Also require KMS-wrapped keys with 30d rotation.
Elaine S: Compliance asks: bump central log sink retention for image-signing events to 90d and include SBOM + manifest provenance in the payload. Current retention is 30d.
Sam W: I'll open a ticket to increase retention and add cosign filters.
Maria (runtime): Runtime will route canaries to -rev1 only initially and warm KV caches. We'll run smoke + perf checks.
Jess - infra: Dry-run signing flow please: build -> push -rev1 -> cosign sign --key k8s://projects/our-kms/keys/cosign-key -> upload SBOM -> canary deploy.
Sam W: Dry-run command (test in CI staging):
```
cosign sign --key k8s://projects/our-kms/keys/cosign-key gcr.io/redwood/base-image:v2026-03-rev1
```
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy: staging-canary 2026-03-11T05:30:00Z, perf-canary 2026-03-11T06:00:00Z
Alex R: Pre-cutover checklist:
- [ ] Create ci-image-signer SA + rolebinding (Jess)
- [ ] Provision KMS key with SIGN usage + rotation (infra)
- [ ] Update audit sink retention & filters (Elaine)
- [ ] CI pipeline cosign KMS step (Sam/Maria)
- [ ] Post-cutover vuln sweep + canary validation (runtime + sec)
Jess - infra: I'll provision SA and KMS today. Ping me for RBAC YAML.
Sam W: We'll run image-sanity, vuln-scan, startup-boot, and p95 perf baseline during canary.
Elaine S: Regulator requirement: include SBOM and signed manifest in audit events. Make sure CI attaches redwood.build.provenance annotation.
Maria (runtime): CI will emit SBOM JSON and attach annotation. Will also prepare dashboards and smoke checks.
Alex R: Rollback policy (emergency): revoke signer SA immediately -> block -rev1 pulls via registry ACL -> restore routing to previous tag. Keep sec on the incident channel.
Sam W: I'll author a rollback runbook and post in incidents channel. Objections to Tue 05:00 UTC? :eyes:
Jess - infra: No objections. :+1:
Elaine S: Compliance OK. :white_check_mark:
Maria (runtime): OK. I'll watch canaries.
Alex R: Locking it in. I'll add note to sec-runbook and monitor.
Sam W: Opening MR for RBAC/pipeline and ticket for audit retention now. Will post links. :rocket:
deploy-bot: MR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/r/image-rebuilds/merge_requests/42
Sam W: Links: MR 42 (rbac + pipeline), TKT-8731 (audit retention). Implementation started. Ping for inspections.
